info.title: CSTOJS CLI
info.description: Dotnet tool/CLI for a C# to JS transpiler.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Dotnet tool/cli frontend for a CSharpToJavaScript library.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Create a barebone 'cstojs_options.xml' in the current directory, without running the dotnet commands.
This command should be used if a C# project already exists.

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Output folder. Can be absolute path or relative.

commands.name: setup
commands.description:
Setup cstojs project in the current directory.
This command should be used if you are starting from scratch.

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: Output folder. Can be absolute path or relative.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the 'cstojs_options.xml'.
Note: The name of the file can be anything as long as the file ends with xml and follows structure `<ProjectOptionx>...</ProjectOptions>`. [default: ./cstojs_options.xml]

commands.name: watch
commands.description:
Watches specified files in the 'cstojs_options.xml' with an interval and translates them. 
Note: The 'cstojs_options.xml' file is not being monitored, so any changes require the command to be restarted.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the 'cstojs_options.xml'.
Note: The name of the file can be anything as long as the file ends with xml and follows structure `<ProjectOptionx>...</ProjectOptions>`. [default: ./cstojs_options.xml]

options.name: --delay
options.description: Delay watching the files again by milliseconds. (1000-10000) [default: 3000]
